name: 连管
tagline: 把每对同色圆点连起来，并填满所有格子。
description: 在浏览器中免费玩连管：用互不交叉的管道连接同色圆点并填满整个棋盘，5 × 5 到 9 × 9，每题只有一个答案。
about: Pipe Link is a path puzzle. The board holds pairs of numbered, coloured dots. Join each pair with a pipe that runs through neighbouring cells, up, down, left or right, so that every cell of the board ends up in some pipe. Pipes can't cross, branch or share a cell.
Every puzzle has exactly one solution: a solver checks each one before it reaches you. The sizes go from a quick 5 × 5 to a twisty 9 × 9.
Play alone to beat your best time, or race friends online on the same puzzle.
howToPlay: Choose a size. The clock starts with the puzzle.
Draw a pipe from a dot through neighbouring cells to the other dot with the same number and colour.
Drawing through another pipe cuts it where they meet; drawing back over your own pipe shortens it.
You can stop a pipe partway and carry on later from its open end.
The puzzle is solved when every pair is joined and no cell is left empty.
controls: Phones and tablets: drag from a dot or a pipe's open end. Lift your finger to lay the pipe.
Mouse: press on a dot and drag.
Keyboard: move with the arrow keys, press Enter on a dot to start a pipe, extend it with the arrows, and press Enter to lay it. Escape cancels.
Pause or start a new puzzle from the bar above the game.
tips: Start in the corners and along the edges: a dot there has few ways out.
Pairs that sit close together usually take the short way; long pipes fill the gaps.
If a cell can only be reached by one colour, that pipe must pass through it.
An empty pocket no pipe can reach means something earlier went wrong.
Pipes don't double back beside themselves: a U-turn alongside your own pipe leaves cells nobody else can fill.

faq.question: Is Pipe Link free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: Does every puzzle have one answer?
faq.answer: Yes. Each puzzle is checked by a solver to have exactly one way to join every pair and fill the board.

faq.question: Do I have to fill every cell?
faq.answer: Yes. Joining all the pairs isn't enough: the puzzle is solved only when no cell is empty.

faq.question: How do races work?
faq.answer: Everyone in the room gets the same puzzle at the same moment, and the first to join every pair and fill the board wins.
